$comment: Rule ids such as [I1] refer to docs/provider-standard.md; the request itself is described in docs/verification.md.
title: Provider Standard v1 validation request
description: What a provider's owner asks a verifier to check, in a Stellar 8004 validation_request. It is published as RFC 8785 canonical JSON: the SHA-256 of those bytes is the request_hash, and the request_uri holds the same bytes. Unknown fields are allowed and ignored, but they are hashed with the rest.

url.description: The HTTPS URL the agent's registration names [I1].

validator.description: The verifier's account: the only one that may answer the request.

requestedAt.description: RFC 3339. It makes each request unique: the registry refuses a request_hash it already has.
